LanguageData.RavenTrap_RisingWall.label: [Raven] Rising Wall Trap
LanguageData.RavenTrap_RisingWall.description: A trap that can generate a huge wall and roof, altering the battlefield terrain when triggered. The size can be adjusted in the mod settings.
LanguageData.Raven_TrapWall.label: [Raven] Energy Barrier Wall
LanguageData.Raven_TrapWall.description: A temporary wall generated by the trap, which will automatically dissipate after a short time.
LanguageData.Raven_Wall_SecretEnergyPattern.label: [Raven] Energy Pattern Wall
LanguageData.Raven_Wall_SecretEnergyPattern.descripti: A decorative wall engraved with ancient energy patterns, seemingly a remnant of some ancient trap technology. It is beautiful and sturdy, but cannot be uninstalled and reinstalled.
